title: office.scribe-append request
description: Validate the scribe's entries against the parsed messages and the rules, append the accepted ones to the session's SCR file, merge topics, move scribed_through to through and commit. A note/title-only call (no entry citing a message) may omit through; it writes the note or title and leaves scribed_through unchanged. Run office.scribe-pending first.

through.description: The last message given to the scribe; never before the file's scribed_through. Required when any entry cites a message or when the call carries neither a note entry nor a title; omitted only for a note/title-only append, which leaves scribed_through unchanged.

items.description: A cited message (msg and quote) or a note (text alone, with by).

quote.description: Exact substring of the cited message.

text.description: Note text, written verbatim (credentials scrubbed) with note in place of a message id.

resolves.description: <SCR id>#L<n>: resolved names a pending line, why names a decision line, a preference note names a decision line it promotes.

why.description: decision, agent-decision and preference only: the reason, checked verbatim against its message or note.

note.description: true (quote from the entry's own note text) or the reason note text.

quote.description: Exact substring of the cited message or note.

matter.description: preference only: a matter slug from the scribe rules.

review_by.description: preference only: review date; 90 days after the entry by default.

supersedes.description: preference only: <SCR id>#L<n> of an existing preference line on the same matter.

by.description: user, or the crew name an agent tag requires.

title.description: Session title; a change renames the file once and records the old id in aliases.
